host.title: Hostname or IP address
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the remote file system server.

remote_path.title: Remote folder path
remote_path.description: Absolute path on the remote file system server to use as the content root (e.g. /data/documents).

private_key.title: Private key
private_key.description: PEM-encoded private key used for SSH authentication.

allowed_extensions.title: File filters
allowed_extensions.description: Restrict ingestion to files whose name ends with one of these extensions.
